'''Sanctuary''', a small, island-dotted [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]], was one of the oldest and most well-known [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[safe world]] colonies, predating the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]]. Sanctuary was originally settled by religious pacifists dodging an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] draft. These colonists joined the Alliance on the condition that they would not have to fight in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the Galactic Empire. So began a mutually beneficial relationship, in which Sanctuary accepted all manner of Rebels and [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiles]] seeking asylum from Imperial oppression in exchange for equipment that would boost the planet's agricultural capability.

As the war progressed, Sanctuary's population swelled to nearly thirty thousand, while the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees']] surplus in [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] production enabled them to export many [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and [[Grain/Legends|grains]] to the Rebel cause each [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Although Sanctuary's location remained strictly classified, the planet's name became synonymous with Alliance safe worlds, as [[Rebel trooper|Rebel troops]] began referring to anyone who mysteriously disappeared as having "found Sanctuary."

==Description==
Sanctuary was a small<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" /> terrestrial [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> located in the [[Sanctuary system]] at the southern edge of [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]], within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Sanctuary was positioned at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] running through the Calamari [[Sector/Legends|sector]]&mdash;the [[Tidal Circuit]] and [[Prously's Rim Run]]&mdash;that eventually connected with the planet [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] itself.<ref name="Atlas" />

A [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] world with a moist [[Hydrosphere/Legends|hydrosphere]], Sanctuary's surface terrain primarily consisted of deep [[Color/Legends|green]] seas and small rocky islands. The planet had a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] breathable<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> for [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="Planets Collection" /> and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Sanctuary lasted twenty-two [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard hours]], and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 312 local days. Sanctuary's oceans boasted an abundance of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] life and [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" />

==History==
Sanctuary was originally settled by a few thousand<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" /> religious pacifists who were attempting to escape enforced<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] conscription. The planet also attracted several [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] who felt discriminated under [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Together, these people colonized a small island chain and used steam-powered [[Boat/Legends|ships]] built from scratch to feed the colony through deep-sea fishing, supplemented by small-scale agriculture.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

Shortly after the formal [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] against the Galactic Empire, Sanctuary reached out to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Although unwilling to directly join the Rebellion's fight,<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" /> the planet's colonists agreed to join the Alliance, provided they did not have to take up arms in the growing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|conflict]]. Alliance [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] agreed to their provision,<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> and the two groups struck a mutually beneficial arrangement: Sanctuary would provide asylum to wounded Rebels, Alliance family members, and [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiles]] for an initial investment in supplies and equipment to increase the planet's agricultural production.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

Sanctuary thus became one of the Rebellion's first<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> and most relatively well-known [[safe world]]s. The Alliance guarded Sanctuary's location at the most restricted levels. Only a few select [[Transport/Legends|transport]] crews tasked with ferrying personnel and supplies to and from the planet were trusted with Sanctuary's coordinates. Rumors of Sanctuary's existence abounded, and a common saying developed among [[Rebel trooper|Rebel troops]] to describe anyone who mysteriously disappeared as having "found Sanctuary," regardless of which safe world they had actually been sent to.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

Over the first few years of the Galactic Civil War, Sanctuary's population swelled to include several thousand new [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], "ending with the establishment of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]." ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the establishment of Echo Base on Hoth to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> Sanctuary's population numbered 29,000, well over the average population of a Rebel safe world.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> Once the planet's fishing and agriculture began to produce far more than the refugees needed, they began trading their surplus to the Rebellion in exchange for common technologies, including [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] and [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]]. Sanctuary also began growing textile crops, becoming a major supplier of [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|Alliance military uniforms]]. By the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Sanctuary was producing a significant portion of Alliance [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and exporting [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of fish and [[Grain/Legends|grain]] each [[Standard month/Legends|month]].<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

==Inhabitants==
Sanctuary's population of 29,000, which included Humans and many refugees of other [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> grew out of the planet's original colonists, who sought freedom from Imperial oppression. A common interest with the Rebel Alliance led to Sanctuary becoming a Rebel safe world in exchange for items that would expand the planet's agricultural capability, which created a synergetic trading relationship between both groups.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

The abundance of fish life and seaweed in the planet's oceans formed the staple of Sanctuary's inhabitants' [[Diet/Legends|diets]]. Sanctuary's [[Fisher/Legends|fishermen]] utilized steam-driven wooden vessels and [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-woven [[Net/Legends|nets]] to catch such a wealth of fish as to be able to export many tons every year to the Rebellion<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> as a source of [[Protein/Legends|protein]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, First Edition">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> Along with an agricultural surplus that furnished [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance military]] uniforms,<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" /> several varieties of Sanctuary's seaweed were found capable of being made into serviceable [[Clothing/Legends|cloth]] for uniforms&mdash;though some [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] claimed they never quite got the fishy smell out.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> In turn, Sanctuary imported common technology items from the Rebellion.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

Sanctuary's denizens lived in independent villages affiliated with the Rebel Alliance. These individuals lived at a feudal technology level, with limited [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] services catering only to the Rebellion.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Sanctuary was first mentioned in the [[October]] [[1990]] first edition of the [[West End Games]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Paul Murphy]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, First Edition" /> Subsequent expansion came in the [[2009]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which established the planet's [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] location in Mon Calamari Space.<ref name="Atlas" />
